params.name: return_score
params.description: Return the user's Sift Score inline with the event response.

params.name: return_action
params.description: Return actions triggered by the event.

params.name: return_workflow_status
params.description: Return the status and decisions of any workflow run triggered by the event.

params.name: abuse_types
params.description: Comma-separated abuse types to score against when return_score is true.

items.docs: Records a user event (reserved types are prefixed with $, e.g. $create_account, $login, $create_order, $transaction, $chargeback, $content_status, plus custom events) so Sift can update its models. Set return_score=true to receive a Sift Score inline, or return_workflow_status=true to receive workflow decisions. The API key is supplied as $api_key in the body or via HTTP Basic auth.
